# ADV-EDIT-01 — TI-trap spring replacement

**The captive spring/actuation member is a replaceable compatible subordinate.** The **original trigger frame and original working striker/discharge block are primary** and must survive in recoverable form for magical reconstruction.

This adopts the body table/register’s replaceability distinction and corrects B-04’s contradictory spring requirement. I verified that the mounted final verdict matches your supplied SHA256.

**Affected recipes:** `recipe-585`, `recipe-588`, `recipe-592`, `recipe-598`, `recipe-599`, `recipe-601`, `recipe-605`, `recipe-609`, `recipe-610`, `recipe-613`, `recipe-619`.

## Corrected controlling rule

> **TI-trap primary and replaceable members:** The original 3-lb trigger frame and original 2-lb working striker/discharge block are primary constituents. Both must survive in recoverable form for magical reconstruction. The 2-lb captive spring/actuation member and its separate subordinate contacts are replaceable, as are compatible supports, catches, grip covers, fittings and feet. Replacement requires actual compatible stock and the applicable restoration procedure; payment alone does not supply a missing part. A replaceable contact is not permission to replace or recreate the original discharge block.
>
> Replacement preserves the same trap identity, its original primary constituents, the **12 × 12 × 3-inch envelope**, **8-lb empty mass**, and the **3/2/2/1-lb body allocation**. It grants no improved mechanism, additional effect or new magical body. A missing or nonfunctional spring prevents discharge until lawful restoration is completed.

This is the **single controlling TI-trap rule** wherever the prior descriptions disagree.

## Exact superseded locations

Line numbers refer to the frozen submitted files, not subsequently generated candidates.

| File and location | Exact editorial disposition |
|---|---|
| `DD_Advanced_167_Source_Authoring_Verdict.md`, **B-04, line 510** | Replace the sentence beginning **“Ordinary supports, catches and grip covers can be replaced…”**, including **“the primary frame/spring/working mechanism must survive,”** with the controlling rule above. Preserve the existing body bill and unrelated trap restrictions. |
| Same verdict, **body-profile table, line 473**, TI-trap primary column | Replace its abbreviated primary description with the canonical `primary` value below. |
| `ADVANCED_167_AUTHORING_REGISTER.json`, **`bodyProfiles["TI-trap"].primary`**, line **16321** | Replace the existing value with the canonical `primary` value below. |
| Same JSON, **`bodyProfiles["TI-trap"].model`**, line **16314** | Replace the ambiguous combined phrase **“captive spring/striker”** using the canonical `model` value below, so the replaceable spring and primary striker/discharge block are expressly separate. |
| Verdict, **AC-09, line 107** | Replace **“missing frame/actuator”** with **“missing model-designated primary frame/actuator”**. Replace **“Replace only subordinate grips/covers/fasteners/contact inserts explicitly allowed.”** with **“Replace only subordinate members expressly permitted by the applicable body profile; for TI-trap, these include its captive spring/actuation member and separate subordinate contacts.”** |

The cited verdict locations are in the :chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}[preserved final source-authoring verdict](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Advanced_167_Source_Authoring_Verdict.md); the JSON locations are in the :chatgpt-content-reference{index="1"}[preserved final decision package](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Advanced_167_Source_Authoring_Decisions.zip).

**Canonical `primary` value:**
```text
Original trigger frame and original working striker/discharge block are primary and must survive in recoverable form for magical reconstruction; the captive spring/actuation member, separate subordinate contacts, supports, catches, grip covers, fittings and feet are replaceable only with actual compatible stock through the applicable restoration procedure.
```

**Canonical `model` value:**
```text
Steel trigger frame, replaceable captive spring/actuation member, and original working striker/discharge block; no loose expendable ammunition.
```

Apply these same definitions to the eleven derived cards and their shared internal/public TI-trap body profile. **This does not change the primary-actuator requirements of TI-auto-tiny, TI-auto-small or any other body.**

## Restoration and history remain unchanged

**KEEP AC-09.** Positive-HP restoration uses its functional-repair schedule: **DC10, `max(1 hour, maximumHP/10 hours)`, and 2.50 gp of compatible repair-material reference** for the 10-gp TI-trap body. A missing spring does not become usable merely because aggregate HP remains positive.

At **HP0**, use the original recipe DC, **`max(8 hours, maximumHP/10 hours)`**, and **25% of the existing finished-unit reference**. Both routes still require the actual trained Tinker’s-tools credential, INT, appropriate station/tools, compatible stock and completed work. Successful repair restores only the HP/function permitted by AC-09; it does not remove a persistent flaw or change the established structural improvement.

**No spring replacement refills charges, performs servicing, resets arming or command/offensive allowances, changes custody, erases prior consumption, or reopens a terminal dismantling claim.** Separate servicing remains necessary when the existing rules require it.

**Boundary:** surviving original frame and discharge block plus a compatible replacement spring can qualify. A surviving spring plus a replacement frame or replacement discharge block cannot restore the original magical trap. A repaired trap with zero remaining charges still has zero charges.

Preserve both conflicting historical statements and record **ADV-EDIT-01** beside them as their controlling correction. This resolves the editorial question only; counts remain **520/687 reviewed and 333/433 public**, with no exact-card, feat or Tinker class-card promotion.

I captured your completed final source-authoring verdict (reply af2a24f6-c967-4aa5-a28e-5c2e9de13cb6; verdict SHA256 48f885becd03e4a99ba8d6243ce286c1e1e88cfefc776af9ff89a9182c79c8e0) and the final 13-file decision package, not the earlier live draft. Please resolve only this conflict within your final source directions:
1. B-04 TI-trap says: "Ordinary supports, catches and grip covers can be replaced; the primary frame/spring/working mechanism must survive."
2. The body-profile table and ADVANCED_167_AUTHORING_REGISTER.json TI-trap primary field say: "original trigger frame and discharge block; spring/contacts replaceable".

The body bill is frame3lb, captive spring/actuation member2lb, working striker/discharge block2lb, fittings/feet1lb. Is the original spring/actuation member primary and irreplaceable for magical reconstruction, or a replaceable compatible subordinate? State the one corrected rule and the exact lines/fields it supersedes. My draft currently conservatively requires the original spring and explicitly retains both conflicting statements pending your answer; this is not an approved new ruling. If replacement is allowed, please retain original frame/discharge identity, same body/envelope/mass, actual compatible replacement stock, real repair cost/time, and no charge/service/custody reset.

This is a narrow editorial clarification, not another broad source conference or an exact-card promotion request. I will apply the answer beside preserved originals and return the actual complete167 candidates/public envelope for the separate exact review. No source deletion, push, cosmology review, feat promotion or Tinker class-card promotion.
